haiku.problem: The wrong answer "Burnt offerings" is the purpose of the bronze altar of burnt offering, which appears in this same passage (38:1). A baker could argue it is true of an altar the passage describes, so it breaks the rule that wrong answers must be false anywhere in the passage.
Where the bronze basin came from is a small detail, not one of the passage's main points. A clearly more important card, such as the seven-lamped gold lampstand (2-11), was left out in its place.
